ILGPU 1.5.3 and ILGPU.Algorithms 1.5.3 compile and execute shared C# Core intersection, stop-aiming, physical tracing and automatic-differentiation kernels on CUDA hardware.
ILGPU.Algorithms package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/ILGPU.Algorithms/1.5.3
Source: https://github.com/m4rs-mt/ILGPU/tree/2efd942cf020da83c32278a6666d57c1d8505077
Package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/ILGPU/1.5.3
